issues.legal_issue: A reduction in the statutory limitation period for seeking a stamp duty refund does not apply to a refund right that accrued before the amendment took effect.
Execution of a cancellation deed before a limitation amendment, despite its registration after the amendment, determines which limitation regime governs the stamp duty refund claim.
A quasi-judicial authority cannot review or recall its final order unless the governing statute expressly confers that power.
A party’s participation in review proceedings cannot confer review jurisdiction on an authority that lacks statutory power to review its own order.
A successful stamp duty refund claimant is entitled to interest for the period the State wrongfully retains the refund amount.
